confidence_notes: Recent city-level price data supports the meal, coffee and beer anchors. Cocktail and wine are less certain: the cocktail estimate is checked against older local data, while the glass of wine is estimated using local beer and bottle-wine prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Poznań city-level aggregated prices; accommodation reflects a mid-sized Polish regional-city market.
